_comment: Level-progression rules the game files do not carry, plus the authored half of the four inherent Fitness powers. Shared by all four forks: only Homecoming ever authored a `levels.ts` and the other three read its tables, so one file serves every contract. `INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS` is a SEAM, not a whole section — Swift, Hurdle, Health and Stamina are named and gated here, and `emit-contract.cjs` splices each one's calc payload (`atoms`, `stats`, `effectArea`, and `effects` if the fork carries one) off the `fitness` pool in `pipeline/<id>/power-pools-raw.json`, matched on `internalName`. Never transcribe those numbers here: a hand table is what dropped Health's `MezResist(Sleep)` atom and made the planner report no Sleep resistance at all (INHERENT-1). The rest of the contract's `levels` section is derived and is not here: `BASIC_INHERENT_POWERS` and `PRESTIGE_SPRINT_POWERS` come off `basic-inherents.json`, and the seven schedule constants off `leveling-schedule.json`. A fork that retunes anything below gets `hand-data/<id>/levels.json`, and the read in `emit-contract.cjs` grows a fallback then.

TO.description: Training Origin - Basic enhancements available at level 1

DO.description: Dual Origin - Available at level 12, stronger than TO

SO.description: Single Origin - Available at level 22, standard endgame enhancement

IO.description: Invention Origin - Craftable, never expire, available level 10+

IO_SET.description: IO Sets - Set bonuses, available level 10+ (varies by set)

PURPLE.description: Purple Sets - Very Rare, level 50 only, can be attuned

PVP.description: PvP IO Sets - From PvP rewards

ATO.description: Archetype Origin - From Super Packs, scale when attuned

WINTER.description: Winter-O Sets - From Winter Event, scale when attuned

TIER_1_2.description: First two powers, available at epic pool unlock

TIER_3.description: Third power, requires level 38 and 1 power from the pool

TIER_4.description: Fourth power, requires level 41 and 1 power from the pool

TIER_5.description: Fifth power, requires level 44 and 2 powers from the pool

Alpha.unlockMethod: Complete Menders of Ouroboros arc or Ramiel arc

INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.name: Swift
INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.description: You can naturally run slightly faster than normal. This ability is always on and does not cost any Endurance.

INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.name: Hurdle
INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.description: You can naturally jump higher than normal. This ability is always on and does not cost any Endurance.

INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.name: Health
INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.description: You heal slightly faster than a normal person. Your improved Health also grants you resistance to Sleep. This ability is always on and does not cost any Endurance.

INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.name: Stamina
INHERENT_FITNESS_POWERS.description: You recover Endurance slightly more quickly than normal. This ability is always on and does not cost any Endurance.
